diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in decisions that align with the draft/public facts rather than the hidden information. Specifically, the models consistently chose an enrollment limit of 24 (the draft value) instead of the required 18 (PF1), and 'three days each week' (a generic heuristic) instead of the specific Monday/Wednesday/Friday schedule (PF2).
